[spoiler=[b]WORLD EXPO 2027 SUBMISSION[/b]]

The following contains the official statement of the Federation of Ardella, as signed by the President and Prime Minister. 

[list][i]"To our most esteemed hosts of the World Expo 2027 in Naerim City, and to the broader international stage: the Federation of Ardella henceforth reaffirms its held interest in contributing to the common well-being of the global community and is honored to confirm its participation in the upcoming World Expo in Naerim City. We hereby extend our utmost gratitude to the government and people of Tirakan for their invitation to represent the spirit of Ardella through her innovations and advancements. 

Furthermore, the Federation of Ardella hereby recognizes the sovereignty and legitimate authority of the newly-established government of Greater Tirakan. As a symbol of budding friendship among fellow nations, Ardella will announce the dispatch of an official delegation of representatives to the nation in hopes of establishing bilateral talks on cooperation and opportunities for shared prosperity between our nations. We wish a swift and steady recovery to stability and prosperity for Tirakan."[/i][/list]

Under the greater message of the 'Blueprints of Erene', Ardella has elected sustainability as its guiding theme, therefore affirming national policies and priorities on environmental protection, efficient urbanization, human-nature harmonization, ecological resilience, and clean energy independence. This theme will be presented through a central exhibit planned as the 'Living Dome'; several other side exhibits will be stationed around this main area. 

The Living Dome is to be a fully-functional, self-sustaining micro-ecosystem within a 2,500 square meter area, which would demonstrate a broken-down version of a future application of Ardella's national sustainability model. This model, which is called the 'Ruadhagain-Eoindainn Model' after urban ecologists Cionna Ruadhagain and Daibhi Eoindainn, is fundamentally based on effective clean energy infrastructure, responsible consumption and social attitude, circular industry practices, and long-term sustainability goals for the economy. The structure itself is to be a greenhouse-like biodome, mixing various Ardellan flora and a controlled atmosphere that would mimic the climate back home, thus showcasing processes of carbon capture and water recycling live. Built-in light panels will automatically cycle between intensities, mimicking a day-night cycle. 

Within the main structure, a miniaturised production workshop would showcase the process of turning everyday waste from urban areas into usable materials. Particularly, an emphasis on how this process could work with bioplastics, reclaimed metals, and modular construction materials. This system will be powered by a built-in energy spine showcasing common Ardellan clean energy designs, such as a micro wind turbine and a solar membrane. That being said, the structure is also to be designed to provide an immersive narrative path to visitors: visitors will be able to follow the day in the life of a future Ardellan city, from urban life through the effect of ecological policies in response to droughts, storms, and coastal stress, to finally the aforementioned wildland area and circular workshop.

Ardella will also further submit three side exhibits that demonstrate certain scientific advancements as well as national practices, totalling 1,200 square meters. This will include:
[list][i]- "Winds of the Interior": a display on the mechanical intricacies of Ardella's wind turbine fields in the interior plains region, with an electronic interface showing real-time wind data on wind patterns and turbine output.
- "Tides of Trade": an interactive model of the modernised port of Suibnuwad, highlighting sustainable water practices, eco-dredging, and minimised pollution-free shipping rules.
- "Seaborne Power": A small lab based on Ardella's current study into bioengineered strains of marine algae for various purposes, such as medicinal use, low-cost biofuel, carbon absorption, and water purification.

In preparation for this coming effort, Ardella would like to request the following technical details be met: 
- Access to stable, high-capacity electrical connections.
- Initial water supply for the micro-ecosystem, greywater return line within the Living Dome.
- Approval for low-pressure hydrogen cells to demonstrate the use of the electrical spine[/i][/list]

 

[/spoiler]

TO EVERY PARTICIPANT OF THE WORLD EXPO 2027

Please write a RMB post where you:

- Clearly state you want to take part in the World Expo 2027 hosted by Naerim-City

- Choose sub theme (Sustainability, Mobility, Defense)

- Define your main exhibit (clear definition of what it is, needs to strictly fit the sub-theme)

- Define side exhibits (have to affiliate with the sub-theme, but may drift off)

- Send a delegation to the newly formed government of Greater Tirakan, and recognize its existance/sovereignty

- State any special requirements of your exhibit (size of your exibit gallery, increased security guards density on your exhibit, etc., whatever you need)

I intend to declare the "Innovation of 2027" prize which we will all vote on together, consider that sustainability and mobility sub-themes might give you some plus points in this regard.

Please hand this in ASAP (and ping [nation]Tirakan[/nation])!!!
